questions.q: Why SvelteKit SSG instead of Next.js or WordPress?
questions.a: SvelteKit Static Site Generation (SSG) compiles HTML at build time with minimal to zero client-side JavaScript. This eliminates the hydration overhead found in Next.js and the database latency of WordPress, guaranteeing instantaneous load times that Google rewards.

questions.q: How do you ensure EEAT compliance?
questions.a: We structure your content to highlight credentials, cite authoritative sources, implement author schemas, and establish clear entity relationships, demonstrating undeniable expertise and trustworthiness to search evaluators.

questions.q: What happens if we need third-party scripts like Google Analytics?
questions.a: We strictly enforce Partytown compliance for all trackers. They run in a background web worker, ensuring they never block the main thread or degrade your Core Web Vitals.
